title: Home Search Ranking

blueprintSignals.name: Price fit
blueprintSignals.definition: position of the price within the buyer's stated range, scaled from 0 to 1
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: The range changes during a search, so use the current one

blueprintSignals.name: Saved and shared
blueprintSignals.definition: saves and shares of this listing by buyers with similar filters in the last 7 days
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Sparse for new listings, so smooth with a prior

blueprintSignals.name: Listing freshness
blueprintSignals.definition: hours since the listing went live, passed through a decay function
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Decay too steeply and a good older home disappears

blueprintSignals.name: Commute fit
blueprintSignals.definition: travel time from the home to the buyer's saved workplace at rush hour
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Routing data is expensive, so precompute for common destinations

engineFeatures.meaning: the item the user is looking at now
the last few items in the session, in order
share of recent items in each category
recent interaction counts, corrected for popularity
time per item and traversal pattern used to remove non-human sessions

label: For "Home Search Ranking": Rank homes for a buyer's search by the likelihood of engagement and fit, balancing relevance, freshness and seller fairness. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Position bias in click logs means top results look better than they are.
